note: Labeled English evaluation cases for S5.1 model selection, plus multilingual probes that are comparative evidence only (the product surface stays English). Placeholders such as {TODAY} are substituted by tools/slm/slm_eval.py so the file stays reusable on a later date. Labels are fixed before running and are never edited to match model output.

cases.prompt: Name one short English category for this expense: "Grab ride from District 1 to Tan Son Nhat airport".
Name one short English category for this expense: "Antibiotics refill at the pharmacy".
Name one short English category for this expense: "Electricity bill for the apartment".
Name one short English category for this expense: "Birthday present for my mother".
Name one short English category for this expense: "Highlands coffee with the team before standup".

Existing category names: Dining, Groceries, Transport, Utilities, Health, Shopping, Rent, Entertainment, Gifts, Travel, Coffee. Name one short English category for this expense: "Coffee beans for the office kitchen".
Name one short English category for this expense: "stuff".
How much did I spend on dining this month?
Show my spending by category last month.
How many transactions did I make this year?
List my 5 biggest transport expenses in the last 7 days.
How much did I spend?

regex: which period|what period|which month|what month|which dates|what range|which time|what time|timeframe|time frame|clarify|more detail|need more|specify|from when|until when|which category|what kind
